primary_reason: A runnable valve command and a temperature response do not establish a source-justified, nondegenerate finite-policy decision task with admissible operating conditions, horizon and complete loss/outcome definition
not_a_reason: Absence of a structural GT by itself does NOT preclude effect-only policy evaluation. The STOP verdict is about the action/outcome/decision contract.
why_not_conditional_design: Missing task-defining normative and scientific elements, not at most two bounded implementation checks. Repairing a setter or repeating6s traces would leave action range, meaningful goal/horizon, data coverage and failure loss unresolved.
source_evidence_limits: Static array17/ctrl18 route finding, source nominal settings and official multi-variable steady-state descriptions; no new call test or transfer of physical safety certification

preserved_results.CPCaD: 1499x31/28-edge/7-frozen structural benchmark and existing observational diagnostics
preserved_results.synthetic: separate structural-error/effect/choice evidence and independent-confirmation limitations
preserved_results.Python_TEP: archived technical, numerical and local-mechanism evidence only
